title: Ask makes icons that are icons: one subject, clean vector shapes, readable at 24 px
goal: Asked for an icon (the user's 'a balloon icon popping'), Ask painted a scene with the picture model and traced it: a stick figure holding balloons. An icon request must give an icon: one subject, built from a few clean vector shapes and paths on an icon grid, consistent line weight and corner style, centred with even padding, readable from 16 to 64 px, every part a named, editable layer, in the style asked for (outline, filled, duotone, or the document's own icon style).
notes: User, 2026-11-04 (intake): 'i tried to create an animated svg of a balloon icon popping. But I think it just drew a picture of a stick figure holding balloons. I'd like to be able to use ask for creating icons and especially animated svgs'. Today: AskPlanning routes 'icon' words to vector art (add_drawing), which is painted by the picture model and traced (AgentPictureKind); the doing tools include add_shape and add_path, which an icon route can use directly. Animation is a separate task: ask-animates-what-it-makes-an-animated-svg-icon.
acceptance: STILL OPEN: 'make an icon of a balloon popping', the user's own request, reads as a balloon bursting: at least 7 of 10 on didWhatWasAsked and reads as an icon, and named as a balloon blind (Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --engine ask --cases icon-balloon-popping). Reached 2026-11-04: 29.7, didWhatWasAsked 3, reads as an icon 4, against 74.4 before.
STILL OPEN: the held-out total is measured on the final prompt and reported beside the climb total (Scripts/ask-eval.sh report).

WHERE THE ICON GOES (user, 2026-11-04, after Ask put a 512 icon frame beside their picture and widened the canvas from about 1026 to 2112): Ask never grows the person's document or adds a frame beside their work to hold an icon. If the current picture is empty (only a Background), it becomes the icon: square, icon sized, the icon drawn on the canvas itself. Otherwise Ask opens a NEW picture sized for the icon in its own window, draws there, and its row says so (Made a new icon: Balloon). No new document kind: File > New stays Image or Video; New Image gets icon size presets (24 pt glyph on 512, 1024 app icon).

Reproduce: 'make an icon of a balloon popping', 'a trash can icon', 'a settings gear icon, outline', 'a rocket app icon' on Ask at Next defaults; record what Ask makes today (screenshots in the audit).

An icon request takes an icon route: drawn with shapes and paths directly (add_shape, add_path) on a square icon canvas or artboard, not painted by the picture model and traced. The route is chosen from the general words for an icon, never from subjects; the subject and its form come from the model's own knowledge (no hardcoded subjects, memory: no-hardcoded-generated-content). If tracing is kept for any case, the subject is reduced to one centred object first.

Icon craft, checked automatically and in the eval rubric: one subject, no people or scenes unless asked; a stroke weight and corner radius consistent across parts; even padding inside the frame; reads at 16, 24 and 64 px (render each and judge); parts named for what they are ('balloon', 'knot', 'string').

An Ask eval case set of at least 12 icon requests across styles, judged by the model judge against references from SF Symbols, Material Symbols and Lucide; before and after totals in the audit; the after must beat the before by a clear margin and score at least 7 of 10 on 'reads as an icon'.
Copy as SVG and export give clean SVG of the icon (paths, no raster).
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

Reached: the 14 icon cases went from 69.3 to 86.5 (run 20261105-004619-ask against 20261104-223110-ask), reads as an icon 5.1 to 7.3, so the eval's bar is met in total. Placement, the 512 and 1024 sizes, named parts, Copy with no picture and one-step undo are walked at Next defaults; shipped in 3e03a854 and f6cdf111.

Left open: the balloon fell from 74.4 to 29.7. The local model keeps the balloon whole with rays round it, which reads as a sun or a ship's wheel. Three instruction changes did not move it (an action happens to the object; a redraw needs a new silhouette; marks on one side and an open outline, which read 25.3 and was reverted). Next idea, untried: the checklist allows tracing a subject reduced to one centred object, so an icon that fails the look could fall back to that; the old traced balloon named as a popping balloon 3 of 3 times.
Left open: the held-out set was not run; it takes about two and a half hours and needs the Mac to itself, and the person kept coming back.

Chose one model-written SVG that lands as shape and path layers over one add_shape or add_path call per part because the layers are the same kind, it is one undo step, and a model writing a picture at once draws better than placing parts blind. This departs from the checklist's wording and was not measured against the per-call way; it is in the audit's rough list.

Chose a new picture for an icon on any non-blank document, and the box itself when a frame is given, because the user said never to grow their document. Several icons with no frame open a window each; left rough, it did not earn a task. Also left rough: an icon's SVG numbers are fractions (a 24 grid does not divide into 512), and the look's trace still says drawings painted by the picture model on an icon request. new-image-icon-sizes-walk proves the rows and the presses, not the 1024 canvas it opens.
Most icons now read and land in the right place (69.3 to 86.5, shipped), but the user's own balloon reads as a sun at 29.7 and the held-out set was not run: both are open on the checklist.
